Corollary
[Trace Harnack estimate and monotonicity of $tR$] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0290, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0291 ↗ thm:chow-ii-hamilton-matrix-harnack 1. ch15:15.3\group Trace Harnack Estimates

Under the hypotheses of Theorem 2, \[ \partial _tR+ rac Rt+2\langle abla R,V angle +2\Ric (V,V)\ge 0. \] Consequently $t\mapsto tR(x,t)$ is nondecreasing and $R(x,t_2)\ge (t_1/t_2)R(x,t_1)$ for $0<t_1\le t_2$.
Proof

\sketch For an orthonormal coframe $\{ \omega ^a\} $, sum $Q((\omega ^a\wedge V)\oplus \omega ^a)\ge 0$ over $a$. The contracted Bianchi identity and $\partial _tR=\Delta R+2|\Ric |^2$ give

\[ 0\le frac 12\partial _tR+ frac {R}{2t}-\langle abla R,V angle +\Ric (V,V). \]

Replace $V$ by $-V$ and multiply by two. Setting $V=0$ gives $\partial _t(tR)\ge 0$, and integration proves the last assertion.
